name: Marisa Monte with Orchestra
description: The legendary Brazilian singer-songwriter Marisa Monte brings her enchanting voice to Porto for a special performance backed by a full orchestra. Expect an unforgettable night of MPB classics and new hits.
longDescription:
Marisa Monte, a prominent figure in Música Popular Brasileira (MPB), performs in Porto on September 20, 2026. Known for her distinctive vocal style and songwriting, Monte has released multiple acclaimed albums and is a four-time Latin Grammy Award winner. This event features her work presented with the accompaniment of a full orchestra, offering a reinterpretation of her extensive repertoire.

Attendees can expect a concert experience at the Super Bock Arena, a large-scale indoor venue designed for major musical events. The performance will showcase a selection of her well-known compositions alongside newer material, presented in an orchestral setting. The event is likely to attract a diverse audience, including long-time fans of Brazilian music and those interested in orchestral arrangements of contemporary works.

Tickets are available for purchase. The Super Bock Arena is located in the Ramalde area of Porto and is accessible via public transport, with metro stations and bus stops within walking distance.
